question: What supreme attainment and favor can one gain from the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together form a great accomplishment
Such accomplishment can arise for a practitioner
The yoginīs may hold that practitioner dear
inference: One may attain the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginīs
plain_english: One may attain the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginīs.
